risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Named in both the Statement of Caution and the MD&A disclaimer as a factor that could make actual results differ materially; directly affects input costs in the textile/garment business.
- The company names cyclical demand and pricing in its principal markets, and changes in industry demand and pricing, as key uncertainties for future performance.
- Listed among the factors that could materially change operations; the MD&A ties the textile outlook to Government support such as the PLI Scheme and PM MITRA Parks.
- The MD&A warns that elevated trade policy uncertainty and further trade fragmentation risk disrupting trade networks, and that persistent inflation could keep interest rates higher for longer. This matters for an exporter.
- Foreign exchange inflow is in USD; the company says it follows 'prudent foreign exchange management practices to support its export operations', so its revenue depends on currency movements.
- Form AOC-2, the related-party contracts form, lists sales of goods or services with related parties Garvit International and SBC Infotech Limited, marked as '10% or more of the annual turnover' and '10% or more of the Consolidated Turnover'. The same form also states there were no material contracts during FY26.
- Economic developments within India and in the countries where the company does business are listed as factors that could make results differ from expectations.
